results.title: Aldnoah.Zero (Re+)
results.overview: A movie compilation of the first and second cours of Aldnoah.Zero and also includes the new animation to conclude the series, Aldnoah.Zero: The Penultimate Truth.

results.title: L'albero
results.overview: Bianca is 23 years old, and it already feels like too much. She has left her parents' home and is supposed to attend university, but she never goes. She has a few specific obsessions: the passing of time, cocaine, and Angelica. Since they started living together, everything seems to move faster, spiraling downwards. Even their friendship stumbles into addiction and becomes confused with love. Bianca keeps a notebook, jotting down notes for her books. Still, she wishes she could write everything in it: that youth is painful and already slipping away, that friendship breaks your heart, and that we constantly lose everything — and yet, maybe, in the end — between the night streets of Rome, the boys of Naples, and the tree that stands silently, visible through the window — nothing will be truly lost.

results.title: Counterfeit Criminal
results.overview: Daniel Cruz, a criminal who's been on the run from the law, is finally caught by the police. In exchange for all his charges being dropped, the police ask for his help in taking down a criminal known as the Green Man, who is running a counterfeit money operation. However, Daniel is forced to work with novice cop, Officer Michael Hudson, who disapproves of Daniel’s criminal methods of getting to the Green Man.

results.title: The Dragon
results.overview: Former professional climber and elite mountain runner Shane Ohly attempts the unimaginable, to conquer the Dragon’s Back Race® in a single, non-stop push. Spanning 380km from Conwy to Cardiff, this iconic Welsh challenge is typically completed over six days. Supported only by a dedicated crew of friends, Shane’s journey is an extraordinary test of physical and mental endurance.

results.title: Ice Grave
results.overview: On July 11, 1897, three men - the Swedish engineer Salomon August Andrée and his companions Nils Strindberg and Knut Fraenkel - set off from Spitsbergen for the North Pole in a hydrogen balloon, a daring attempt to conquer the Arctic from the air. Contact is lost after a few days. They are never seen again. Thirty-three years later, on August 6, 1930, a sealing ship makes a chilling discovery on the remote Island of Kvitøya, the northernmost part of Svalbard. The expedition’s remains, bodies frozen in time beneath the snow, alongside journals and undeveloped film material. Ninety-three of the 240 recovered photographs are salvaged. The documentary reconstructs this expedition between delusion and vision, between scientific ambition and human vulnerability as a compelling mosaic of past and present – ​​an archaeological crime thriller about the price of discovery, the beauty of the unknown, and the melting of memory in the ice of time, with a touch of tragic, unrequited love.

results.title: Eidolon
results.overview: A man desperate to disappear must embrace the very past he's running from when a relentless genetically enhanced killer hunts him down.

results.title: BEAMED
results.overview: A rideshare drivers unexpected encounters with riders leads to a extra-terrestrial encounter.

results.title: The Fire Raven
results.overview: A group of powerful and corrupt individuals of varying backgrounds turn Doma City into a 'hell island', where high schooler Xiaodi is brutally raped and murdered. Fifteen years later, these manipulators meet a series of gruesome deaths. Fang Tianyang, who witnessed the murders, and police officer Fang Zhengnan delve into the investigation, only to discover that this anonymous killing is not simply revenge, but a belated indictment. A series of murders, layers of darkness—how many untold sins lie hidden behind the black web woven by power, money, and desire?

results.title: Marcie's
results.overview: Marcie has a dream: to own Ed's Tavern, where she's bartender and den mother to a devoted small-town community. But when a developer sets his sights on Ed's wooded land, Marcie's future is upended. As she rallies her people, she finds that an endangered bird may hold the key to preventing the loss of the tavern and saving her community.

results.title: The Red Room
results.overview: In this pseudo-vintage short, silent film based on the story by H.G. Wells, a young man chooses to spend the night in a supposed haunted room.

results.title: Straight Line
results.overview: A unique man makes unexpected connections while attempting to walk through New York City in a perfectly straight line.

results.title: Dolph: Unbreakable
results.overview: From a troubled upbringing in Sweden to global stardom, the film explores Dolph’s hidden battles—including childhood trauma, chronic injuries and a brutal cancer diagnosis—and his relentless drive to survive, reinvent and inspire.

results.title: Messenger
results.overview: After a heartbreak, engineer Sakthi attempts suicide but is saved by messages from Anandhi, a deceased Facebook friend. He falls in love with her spirit and marries her, until she threatens to leave, testing their supernatural bond.

results.title: Scattered Pictures
results.overview: Through the grainy nostalgia of 8mm film and the intimacy of voice-over narration, Gabriel takes us on a deeply personal journey of self-discovery.

results.title: Qorin 2
results.overview: Fitri, a young guidance counselor, wants to uncover a bullying case involving one of her students. But Fitri's investigation leads her to a horrifying reality when she witnesses people connected to the case die one by one, only to reappear the next day.

results.title: City Child
results.overview: It’s winter in Berlin. Two couples meet, and although they exchange only a few glances and even fewer words, the outlines of an obscure plot emerge, as if a complex psychological thriller was unfolding just outside the frame.

results.title: Ashes Under the Sand
results.overview: A trio of “cleaners” working at the bottom of a blue-collar crime syndicate handle the jobs no one else wants, but when a routine job goes wrong, their attempt to clean up their own mess only pulls them deeper into the world they’ve been trying to escape.

results.title: Melanochaita
results.overview: In the heart of the busy National Zoo , on an ordinary quiet day, visitors wander captivated by exotic creatures in their enclosures , unaware that somewhere in the labyrinthine garden, an empty cage is about to change their lives forever .

results.title: Mouthfeel
results.overview: After a tumultuous breakup with her powerful wine importer ex, struggling wine rep Rachel fights to carve out her own place in New York’s cutthroat beverage world—all while battling a fragile sobriety, temptation, and the ghosts of her past.

results.title: A Family Stain
results.overview: At his girlfriend's family's formal dinner, Mateus, an anxious young man, attempts to conceal his secret from the bizarre family members who suspect him.
